rules: .menu-card.small { width: 380px; padding: 30px; background: var(--bg); border: 2px solid var(--c); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.4); }
.brand { font: 900 64px/0.95 var(--font); color: #fff; letter-spacing: 4px; text-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--c); }
#res-laps { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 16px; }
#res-total { font: 900 38px var(--font); text-align: center; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--c); }
#res-place { font: 900 30px var(--font); text-align: center; color: var(--m); text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--m); }

button { pointer-events: auto; font: 700 20px var(--font); letter-spacing: 3px; color: #dff; background: rgba(6, 14, 46, 0.8); border: 2px solid var(--c); padding: 16px 22px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
  clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 14px), calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 14px); transition: all 0.15s; }

button { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
scope: Reused prepared browser snapshot; no new browser/graphics execution. Layout for offline native placeholders uses this fixed source card; account/next-road behavior not imported.
